blocks.text: Jab conductor ke siron par potential difference V lagaya jaye to us mein current I behne lagta hai.

blocks.title: Ohm ka qanoon
blocks.text: Conductor mein behne wala current conductor par lagaye gaye potential difference ke seedhe tanasub mein hai, basharte conductor ki tabai halat (physical state) mein koi tabdeeli na ho (print mein 'no charge'). Riyazi taur par V, I ke tanasub mein, ya V = RI ... (9.31).
Yahan R ek constant hai jise conductor ki resistance kehte hain. Resistance ki SI unit ohm hai, jise Yunani bara harf omega zahir karta hai.

blocks.title: Ek ohm
blocks.text: Conductor ki resistance 1 ohm hai agar us ke siron par 1 volt ka potential difference lagane se us mein 1 ampere current behe.

blocks.caption: Ohm ka qanoon ek nazar mein

blocks.prompt: Conductor 6.0 V se jorne par us mein 3.0 A current hai. Us ki resistance kya hai, aur kitni power istemal hoti hai (MCQ 9.8)?
blocks.explanation: R = V/I = 6.0/3.0 = 2.0 ohm, aur P = VI = 6.0 x 3.0 = 18 W, option (d).

items: Ohm ka qanoon: agar tabai halat (maslan temperature) na badle to I, V ke tanasub mein; V = RI (9.31); R ohms mein; 1 ohm 1 V par 1 A guzarta hai.
